steps.name: Cursed Traces
steps.objective: Talk to [Anastasia] in "Atlantis", then uncover Atlantis's past at the Chimera Research Lab.

lines.text: (You arrive by submarine in the underwater city of Atlantis. Beneath the briny smell of the water lies a peculiar atmosphere unlike anything on the surface.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So this is Atlantis... I think they said Mayor Anastasia was somewhere around here...
Who are you? I don't believe I've seen you before...
(A woman in a black coat approaches from in front of a building, noticing the stranger. Her unwavering expression carries an inexplicable chill.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm %s, an adventurer. Mr. Gatia Su referred me here to Atlantis.
Gatia...?

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Then you've come to the right place. I am Anastasia, mayor of Atlantis.

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: What is it you want?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She seems rather uncomfortable.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, let me explain. I'm looking for Iris...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly explain King Hejong's command and your search for Iris.)

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Iris Livier...

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: The last descendant of the legendary Tyr people... She set out on a journey to confront the Demon King, and is now missing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know Iris?

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Of course. I met her in person and helped her with her work.

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: You don't know much about Iris, do you? Perhaps...

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Perhaps you wouldn't. In any case...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What was that pause about...?)

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Miss Iris's journey shook a world that had been quiet for many years, bringing many changes.

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: It is difficult to put into words, but one thing is certain: many people sense chaos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure I understand. Are you saying you'll help me?

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: I can offer a little help, though not everything you need. I have no clue where she is now, but I can tell you where she went...

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: It is an old trail. Will that suffice?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's fine.

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Miss Iris headed for my hometown, Midgard. She said she would take the orbital elevator, Bifrost, to Asgard.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Midgard...

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Getting to Midgard will be harder than you expect. You'll need a map.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You'll make me a map?

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Yes. In return, I would like you to carry out a request.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do?

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Beyond Atlantis is a place called the Chimera Laboratory. It stands as a symbol of Atlantis's past sins...

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: I would like you to retrieve a relic from its central chamber.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What exactly am I looking for?

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Once you get there, you will know it when you see it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. All right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She seems to be hiding something. I suppose I'll go take a look...)
(You turn toward a place where something feels wrong and see someone surrounded by monsters.)
Hey, is someone there? I know you're there! Help me!
(A woman waves, calling for help. For someone in danger, her voice sounds remarkably playful.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Is she really all right?)
What are you doing? I said, help me!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hold on!
(Just as you push the monsters back to rescue her, the woman's eyes change. A tremendous volley of bolts erupts from her crossbow.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Amazing...

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Pay attention. You said you'd help—are you just going to stand there in a daze?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, right.
(Soon, every monster in front of you has fallen. A few seem to have fled.)

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Whew, all done. You saved me.
(The woman with the crossbow beams and offers her hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're welcome. But what were you doing here?

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: You're an adventurer hired by Atlantis, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'm here on a job.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: My job's much the same. I was asked to investigate what's happening in the Chimera Laboratory.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: But I never imagined it would be a place like this. My fault for jumping into something so dangerous.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Mayor Anastasia never mentioned any of this. Hmph. Doesn't she make rather too light of sending people to work for her?
(The woman with the crossbow pours out complaint after complaint.)

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Oh, sorry. I'm talking too much, aren't I? Looking at you closely, you seem pretty capable. Let's go together.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: I won't slow you down too much. I'm more useful than I look, so take me along. Please?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. This place does seem tougher and more dangerous than I expected...

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Don't be shy. All's well that ends well, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Since we're both here on laboratory business, let's go together.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Then I'm counting on you, %s.
(The woman with the crossbow talks nonstop as you head toward the laboratory's center.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And then?

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Let's just say my sister is terribly mean. Ahahaha.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Anyway, isn't this supposed to be the Chimera Laboratory, where all the finest achievements of ancient Atlantean science are gathered?

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: It's damp, it smells strange, it hurts my eyes, and it's full of weird things. Hardly a place for someone as refined as me!

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: I expected something glittering and precious. This is such a disappointment. I'm exhausted...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth happened here?

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Yes, what did happen here? Hehe.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: I'm suddenly reminded of Aoich's cherry blossoms. Ah, I miss them. Sitting by the lake, feeling the cool breeze and falling petals... It was lovely.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You mean Cherry Lake.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Yes. I used to live there. Memories, I suppose... I wonder how that child is doing.
(The woman with the crossbow smiles brightly, as though remembering someone dear to her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sure they're doing well.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: You think so? Sorry for talking to myself. Shall we get going? Let's hurry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, let's.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: (Hehe. If we're any later, it won't be nearly as entertaining.)
(The woman with the crossbow remains silent for a long time. Then she raises a hand, as though she has something to say.)

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: You're awfully quiet. Mind if I talk? It's a little boring keeping silent... You'll find it interesting too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's information about the place we're investigating, I'd like to hear it.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Good. I thought you would. You see, this place is truly revolting. It's steeped in Atlantis's original sin.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Original sin?

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Obsessed with science, the people of Atlantis meddled with something they should never have touched. They did terrible things to the giants here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's...

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: The few giants still scattered around here didn't always look like this. They were no different from humans, apart from their size.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: They lived quietly in deep mountains and wild lands, alongside other living things... Then the Atlanteans captured them...
(The woman starts to illustrate something with her hands, then stops.)

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: And horrifically transformed them into what they are now. Monsters, you might say...

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Then they tried to use those results to make themselves stronger. Did they really think they could become gods?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did that really happen?

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: You can hardly believe it, can you? Neither can I. Anyway! The price was a catastrophe that nearly destroyed them.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: They wanted to be like the Aesir, masters of the heavenly city. And it was the Aesir who passed judgment on them. Even those gods must have been horrified.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: They could never have imagined that what they'd done for this land would turn into something so dreadful.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Human greed always comes full circle. Just like their past, this land's past... and the future that will someday repeat it.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Under their judgment, the city fell into the sea. It must have been quite a sight, don't you think? A magnificent thing. Those who sin must face judgment.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: But those humans...

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Oh, never mind. Anyway, they seem to have preserved the laboratory as a reminder not to forget their past sins. Something like that.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: But it makes no sense. If they meant to take responsibility, they wouldn't have abandoned these giants with nothing left but hatred.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Hypocrites... Perhaps I'm a hypocrite too. I hoped I wasn't, but here I am, walking the path of a sinner.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Ahahaha, was that too serious? I get like this sometimes.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Don't dwell on what I said. Don't take it too seriously, either. All right? Shall we go? We're nearly there.
(The woman with the crossbow walks ahead. As she passes, her face is full of loneliness—a sharp contrast to her lively chatter a moment ago.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It feels like she had more to say. Oh, I don't know. Let's just finish things here and go back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, let's go together!
(The woman with the crossbow stops as soon as you enter the chamber.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is...

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: That's right. The heart of the laboratory. It feels a little more heavily guarded than the rest, doesn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are more machines here...

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: You said you had something to find, right? Go look for it. I'll take care of my own business in the meantime.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I will.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Hehe...
(Humming to herself, the woman with the crossbow looks around. Then she begins fiddling with a machine farther inside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's have a look, then...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are there so many cables here? I almost tripped... Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A suspicious box sits in front of you.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this it? A Chimera Core Box...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This must be it, but it's empty. I hope the contents are somewhere nearby...

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Can't find what you're looking for?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I don't see it.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Do you mean this, perhaps?
(The woman with the crossbow takes something from inside her coat and shows it to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that... I think that was in the box. Could you give it to me for a moment so I can check?

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: And if I say no?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Do you know what this is? A Chimera core, used to create dolls in the exact likeness of humans.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Why did Atlantis make such a thing? And why did they put it in there? To make more someday? I suppose they still haven't let go of their desire to become gods.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Surely they know how pitiful the beings made by humans on the path to corruption are. The proof is all around us.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: They do seem to feel some shame, sending you to retrieve this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You...
(The air around the woman with the crossbow changes. Something about her feels disturbingly wrong.)

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Fine, I'll give it to you. Here, catch.
(The woman with the crossbow tosses the core she was holding to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, this... It's broken.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Listen carefully. Don't get angry. I used it. Hehe... Make sure you tell that woman Anastasia.

lines.speaker: 석궁을 든 여성
lines.text: Tell her Choen Palm used the Chimera socket. I wonder what face Anastasia will make when she hears. Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Choen Palm...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Urgh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This terror, pressing down on my mind...)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: That's right. I'm Choen Palm. The one who's going to put a hole through that thick skull of yours.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: It's irritating, seeing you hold out like that...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Now that it's come to this, I'll finish you quickly. Consider it your bad luck to have met me here!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Oh, not bad.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: You're perfect to play with, but why won't you fall?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you doing this to me?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: You really don't know? Then I'll make it perfectly clear. Hm? What's this?
(Choen Palm stops attacking and looks toward the exit, apparently sensing someone's presence.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: An uninvited guest.

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: What on earth is happening here...? Y-you're Choen Palm?!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: As clueless and troublesome as ever, aren't you?

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: You have no right to say that!
(Anastasia raises a sword and charges at Choen Palm.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Where did Anastasia's sword come from? And Choen Palm dodged it in an instant...)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: It's my first time seeing that black blade, but it won't work on me. You know that, Anastasia.

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: What exactly are you doing here?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Just what it looks like. I was interested in Atlantis's ugly, rotten past. That's all.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Whew...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: You're all such a nuisance. I'll stop here. I'm leaving.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Choen Palm...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Listen, adventurer from who knows where. I'll give you credit for withstanding my attacks. But don't get the wrong idea—I'm not leaving because you're too much for me.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: And don't even think about looking for Iris. You'll never find her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why do you think I won't be able to find Iris?
(Choen Palm's expression twists slightly, then quickly returns to its usual composure.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Think whatever you like.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Well, I'm off. Bye!
(An unfamiliar darkness suddenly gathers around you. Choen Palm quickly steps into it, as though being swallowed.)

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: She's gone...

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Still a woman one can never let one's guard down around. More importantly, are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: I see. I'm sorry, but could you explain what happened here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly explain what happened to Anastasia.)
(As though realizing something, Anastasia begins operating the devices farther inside.)

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: What Choen Palm tampered with was...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Choen Palm was after information on the [Homunculus] Project...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is that?

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: I'm sorry. That's... No, I'll tell you. Atlantis's affairs caused this, and you've become involved. You deserve to know.

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: The Homunculus Project... It was a project to create [artificial humans] using the Chimera core I asked you to recover.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did you ask me to get it?

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: I wanted to store it securely. As a reminder of our past wrongdoing... But Choen Palm seems intent on using it.

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: To do such a thing, when she looks on this place with such disgust...

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Judging by the condition of the case, this seems to have been done quite some time ago.

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: We don't know what Choen Palm intends, and there's nothing more we can do here. Shall we return for now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's return to Atlantis. Though what Choen Palm said still bothers me...)

steps.name: Back to the Dark Moon Castle
steps.objective: Talk to [Anastasia] in "Atlantis", then return to "Aoich".

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: I've gathered what information I can, but I still don't know why Choen Palm is doing this.

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: I'll continue investigating. You should continue on your own path. And here is the map...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for the map. Where should I go, then? I'm looking for Iris...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Where should I go?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She definitely mentioned cherry blossoms... Maybe...

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: You've thought of somewhere.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be going. I may be able to learn something...

lines.speaker: 아나스타샤
lines.text: Then take care on your way...

steps.name: Battle at the Owl Castle
steps.objective: Hear the details from the [Dark Moon Lord] in front of "Dark Moon Castle", then enter "Owl Castle". Help the [Dark Moon Princess] at the "Owl Castle Watchtower" inside.

lines.text: (There is a commotion outside Dark Moon Castle. The Dark Moon Lord stands outside, looking troubled and deep in thought.)

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Ahhh, she may be my daughter, but she does whatever she pleases.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, my lord.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Oh, %s! What brings you here?! Welcome! Thanks to you, I'm in good health. Ahahaha!

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Hahaha. Cough, cough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you really all right?

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: I'm quite all right. Hahahaha!

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: I thought you'd visit again, but I didn't expect it to be today. What luck!

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Have you been well? If you've come back to Dark Moon Castle, there must be a reason.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes... Though I'm not sure whether I should tell you...

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Go ahead. It's all right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, if you say so...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell the Dark Moon Lord about meeting Choen Palm.)

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: I suspected as much... So it's about Choen. You met that girl, then.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: I'd rather not tell the princess, but she wants to know... I suppose there's no choice.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Then please tell the princess yourself. Though she'll be more willing to listen if she has reason to be grateful to you first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tell the princess directly?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know she doesn't think very well of me, but...

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: All the better, then. Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I have a feeling he's about to put me to work...)

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: The princess is currently clearing out the remnants of an evil faction hiding in Owl Castle. She went in saying, “Father, I'll take care of everything”...

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: But I can't help worrying. Hahaha. No harm in lending a hand, is there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You want me to go inside and help her, right?

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Exactly. May I ask that of you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I don't mind.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Please do. And I'm sorry. The princess is bound to react strongly. She doesn't mean any ill toward you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry. I'll pass the message on.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be on my way, then.
(After making your way deep inside, you spot the Dark Moon Princess. She appears to be in a standoff, surrounded by assassins.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Princess, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Oh, you... This is rather too many coincidences. Did you come to help?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She's clearly in danger, yet she asks so casually...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'll help you.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Stay on your guard!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah!
(The Dark Moon Princess's arrow strikes an assassin who has appeared behind %s.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Whew. This area's handled. I can take care of it. If you want to help, chase the remaining White Hood members who fled.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: And...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Right. I'll tell you, just in case. Lord Tengu has been bound by a spell. So if you do run into him—if you really do—run away immediately. Understand?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: He's not someone you can handle.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I will.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...All right. Go on, then.

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: You... have considerable skill. May I see a little more of it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Um, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: Even in this situation, you are concerned for me?
(Tengu studies %s, then senses someone approaching.)

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: The princess.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Lord Tengu! Stop!

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: I thought the princess would come, but this is rather sooner than expected.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: If that is your wish, Princess, I shall stop.
(Tengu steps back, closes his eyes, and murmurs quietly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... You've shrunk.
(The Dark Moon Princess stares at the now-small Tengu, looking bewildered.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Lord Tengu, weren't you being controlled by a spell?

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: Hmm, Princess. Aren't you underestimating me? Even your parents and their ancestors would struggle to control me.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Then why were you fighting with that overwhelming power a moment ago?

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: I saw someone with the potential to become a tengu, so I decided to test them briefly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The potential to become a tengu?

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: Haha, don't concern yourself with that. You have much to do in the days ahead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, all right...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Honestly, you made me worry for nothing.

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: Thank you, Princess. You're growing into a fine young woman.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: D-don't say things like that!
(After exchanging a few words with the Dark Moon Princess, Tengu turns his gaze toward %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Lord Tengu? What is it?

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: You... have something to tell us, don't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, right. Well...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Why hesitate? Just say it. I'll listen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, then...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell the Dark Moon Princess and Tengu about meeting Choen Palm.)
(The princess's face pales slightly. Tengu looks at her with concern.)

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: Princess, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I'm fine, Lord Tengu.

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: Very well. About Choen...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Lord Tengu, please be quiet for a moment.

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Choen must have a reason. She has to! Don't speak ill of her...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But still...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: This is all Iris's fault! Her foolishness put the world in danger!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I saw it myself. The many [Demon Kings] that appeared beyond time and space because of Iris...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What in the world did the princess see...?)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Choen wanted to stop that. The things she's doing now, too...

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: Princess... You know, don't you?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Be quiet, Lord Tengu! I don't know! I don't want to hear it! I have to find Choen. I don't know what she's doing, but if I don't go and see her... Maybe...
(No sooner has she finished speaking than the Dark Moon Princess hurries outside.)

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: Poor princess... Clinging to words she cannot bear to doubt... I should have roasted that fiery little chick properly when it showed up.

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: Perhaps things will be all right, at least for a while. The course of the heavens is never wholly ill-fated.
(Tengu looks steadily at %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lord Tengu?

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: If your paths cross again, be a friend to the Dark Moon Princess. She acts strong, but she has a tender heart.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes... I will.

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: Go after her now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Princess...

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: Well, this is goodbye for now. I suspect we'll meet again before long. Until then.

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: Oh, yes. Go see Tamori. There will be something for you to do.
(As soon as he finishes, Tengu vanishes on a breeze that blows from nowhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... He's gone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What a gentle breeze... But what is it I'm supposed to do?

lines.speaker: 타모리
lines.text: I need to follow the princess...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That person who was chasing Ame was Tamori, right?)

lines.speaker: 타모리
lines.text: Oh, you. You just went to see the princess, didn't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 타모리
lines.text: She left in a state, saying she had to find Choen... Did something happen?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, well...

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Tamori, don't press our guest.

lines.speaker: 타모리
lines.text: My lord, I will go and bring the princess back. If she is that upset...

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Whew. I have something for you to do here.

lines.speaker: 타모리
lines.text: ...Yes. Then what about the princess...?

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: %s, please follow her. When Choen is involved, she can neither see nor hear anything else.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: I think there's something she hasn't told anyone all this time. If it were simply news of Choen, perhaps... But...

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: She's learned something about what Choen intends to do...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Then perhaps it could be connected to Iris...

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Perhaps, perhaps not. But one thing is certain: she'll be going to the place she visited with Miss Iris, hoping to find Choen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Where is that?

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Midgard... Where they went to seek answers from the Aesir. Cough, cough.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: If you don't know where she went, find Shino at the tavern. She's from Aoich. Tell her I sent you, and she'll understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, understood.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: I'm sorry to have to ask this of you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I'll go right away.
(The tavern in Midgard is bustling. Inside, a beautiful woman in traditional Aoich clothing moves busily among the guests.)

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: Welcome, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you Miss Shino? I've come from Dark Moon Castle...

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: Has something happened to the lord?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, he asked me to pass on his regards while I was here.

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: I see. Still, you look as though there's something you want to know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know where the Dark Moon Princess went?

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: Surely the princess isn't looking for someone called Choen?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: I don't know much myself, so you needn't say any more. Let me tell you something else instead.

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: Not long ago, I heard that a short-haired woman entered Bifrost. She was carrying a crossbow, so...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Miss Shino. I'll head straight to Bifrost.

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: Oh, Adventurer?

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: I was going to tell you the orbital elevator was broken, but you've already left...
(At the summit of Valhalla, a place steeped in an inexplicable sense of foreboding, Choen Palm stares at the sky, her expression twisted.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Choen Palm...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: You managed to get all the way here? Why do I have so many visitors today?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: I wish the princess hadn't come... This is the worst.
(Choen Palm looks at the Dark Moon Princess, who lies on the ground.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Choen, don't...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Princess, you're in my way, so I'll have to move you aside. ♬ Bear with the pain, all right?
(Smiling, Choen Palm punches the Dark Moon Princess in the stomach as she approaches.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Urgh... Choen...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Good girl, Princess. Just go to sleep for now.
(Choen Palm lays the unconscious princess to one side, then turns to the uninvited adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The ominous power I felt here... It was Choen Palm's.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Welcome to Valhalla, adventurer summoned by the Tyr.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: You've done well to crawl all the way up here. If Iris chose you, I suppose you really must be different.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: You came all this way believing you stand for justice, didn't you?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: You're utterly oblivious. You don't know what you're doing, or what it's for.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: You simply strike down everything that stands in your way. You know nothing of the truth of this world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The truth of this world?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Yes. The truth.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: The good and evil this world knows, its light and shadow... All contradictions. Perhaps a greenhorn like you is better off not knowing.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: All the monsters that have died in this [world]... Were they truly [evil] that deserved to be hunted down by you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Filthy.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Filthy. Filthy.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Filthy. Filthy. Filthy.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: It makes me feel absolutely filthy!
(Blue flames rise from Choen Palm's body.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This power...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Since I've come here as a sinner, I'll commit a proper sin. Now, Adventurer, I have a gift for you.
(The blue flames grow, beginning to envelop Choen Palm. A moment later, an enormous bird rises from within them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Th-that is...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Don't thank me. You deserve it.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: I'll give you the flames of punishment, the judgment of purification...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Die here in your arrogance!
(After a fierce battle, the bird's blue flames gradually fade. Little by little, Choen Palm's form becomes visible within them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it over?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: You think it's over? Arrogant creature...
(At Choen Palm's words, the fading blue flames flare up again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: What a fool. You don't even know who you were fighting, do you? Holding out like that without understanding a thing...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Since it's come to this, shall I test my newfound power? Can you endure it this time too?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: I'll show you the true form of an Agasura.
(As Choen Palm finishes speaking, you sense a tremendous power stirring.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This is completely different from anything I've felt before. It's like...)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Can you feel the abyss? Can you?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is that endless depth the abyss? It feels like someone is reaching out... It makes my skin crawl. What is this...?)
(An unknown power approaches %s and begins to envelop you.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I-I can't breathe.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Feel how unjust they are—the justice and providence you've believed in.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Then crawl beneath the darkness. Forever, never able to rise again...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (M-my consciousness is fading...)

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: [Stop.]
(As a voice reaches your fading consciousness, %s's legs give way. Then Choen Palm screams and begins writhing in pain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Urgh... What happened? I feel better... Was that voice a hallucination? But Choen Palm...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: A-aaaargh! Get out! You doll!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, that's...
(The faint figure of a boy appears before Choen Palm. He seems like an apparition, almost a spirit.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris? No. He feels similar to Iris, but... That boy isn't Iris.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: How dare you... A mere doll, doing this to me... Get out of my head! I thought I'd erased you with the Crack! I thought I'd destroyed you! Why are you coming out of there?!
[...Do you still see me as a doll you made? You poor child...]

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Shut up. Shut up...
[...Goodbye.]

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He's gone...)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Damn it... Cough, cough.
(Blood begins to run from Choen Palm's mouth.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Choen...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Don't say my name!
(Biting her lip, Choen Palm staggers toward the exit.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Consider yourself lucky that I'm retreating like this.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Next time, everyone involved will die. No, they have to die! Cough, cough...
(Choen Palm gazes briefly at the fallen Dark Moon Princess, then disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What exactly is the power Choen possesses...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And that boy who appeared... I don't know.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Ch-Choen...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Why... Why would you...?
(The Dark Moon Princess sobs, then falls silent, apparently losing consciousness again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd better get the princess out of here. If I take her to Miss Shino...
(As you support the Dark Moon Princess, the tears gathered at her eyes scatter like the cherry petals you saw in Aoich, falling far below the orbital structure.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Princess...

translation.method: Fresh translation from the current Korean source
